    SELECT T1.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(T2.HADM_ID) AS SURVIVED_COUNT
    FROM PATIENTS AS T1
    JOIN ADMISSIONS AS T2 ON T1.SUBJECT_ID = T2.SUBJECT_ID
    JOIN DIAGNOSES_ICD AS T3 ON T2.HADM_ID = T3.HADM_ID
    WHERE T3.ICD9_CODE = 'Gastrointestinal Hemorrhagic NOS Otherwise Specified'

ORDER BY T1.SURVIVED_COUNT DESC
